description: Rigid transform from the probe-tracking frame of the Scan&Paint 3D export to the analysis frame: x_frame = R x_raw + t. z normal to the plane through the lowest 10 percent of probe positions, x along the dominant intensity direction, origin at the point of maximum pressure at 750 Hz (Microflown oriented export). Least-squares fit, residual 3.2e-12 m.
